observations.body: Apostles become a spectacle while Corinth reigns. Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another. Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.
